info.name: Insure AI
info.description:
Local API collection for the Insure AI services.

**Setup**
1. Import this collection and `insure-ai.local.postman_environment.json`, then select the *Insure AI - Local* environment.
2. Fill `callerClientId` and `callerClientSecret` in the environment (see `docs/keycloak.md`).
3. Run *Auth > Get access token*, then any request. Creating a customer or quote stores `customerId` / `quoteId` for the following requests.

**Default local ports**: Keycloak 8280, Quote Service 8281, Customer Service 8282.

**Scopes**: `quote:create`, `quote:read`, `customer:create`, `customer:read`.

Every request sends a fresh `X-Correlation-Id`.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Keycloak token endpoint used by every other request.

request.description:
Obtains an access token from the local Keycloak realm using the client-credentials grant and stores it in the `accessToken` environment variable.

Prerequisites (see `docs/keycloak.md`): a caller client whose access tokens carry the `quote-service` and `customer-service` audiences and the scopes `quote:create quote:read customer:create customer:read`. Fill `callerClientId` and `callerClientSecret` in the selected environment; never commit them.

item.name: Customer Service
item.description: Owns customer profiles. Default local address: `{{customerBaseUrl}}`.

request.description:
Creates a customer profile.

- Required scope: `customer:create`
- `fullName`: 2-80 characters
- `email`: valid address, at most 254 characters (stored lower-cased)
- `phone`: E.164, for example `+14155552671`
- `dateOfBirth`: ISO date in the past

Responses: `201` created, `400` `VALIDATION_FAILED` / `BAD_REQUEST`, `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED`, `403` `ACCESS_DENIED`, `500` `PERSISTENCE_FAILURE` / `INTERNAL_ERROR`.

Errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code` and the request's `correlationId`. Send `X-Correlation-Id` (1-64 chars of `A-Za-z0-9._-`) to choose your own; otherwise one is generated and returned in the response header.

item.name: Quote Service
item.description: Owns quotes. Default local address: `{{quoteBaseUrl}}`. v1 takes customer details in the request; v2 references a customer owned by Customer Service.

request.description:
Creates a quote from caller-supplied details.

- Required scope: `quote:create`
- `customerName`: 2-80 characters of letters, space, `.`, `'` or `-`
- `age`: 18-75
- `coverageAmount`: greater than zero
- `coverageType`: `AUTO`, `HOME`, `LIFE` or `HEALTH` (case-insensitive); base rates 0.07 / 0.05 / 0.09 / 0.08
- Premium = `coverageAmount` x base rate, +15% when age is over 60, rounded to 2 decimals

Responses: `201`, `400` `VALIDATION_FAILED` / `INVALID_QUOTE_REQUEST` / `BAD_REQUEST`, `401`, `403`, `500` `PERSISTENCE_FAILURE` / `INTERNAL_ERROR`.

Errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code` and the request's `correlationId`. Send `X-Correlation-Id` (1-64 chars of `A-Za-z0-9._-`) to choose your own; otherwise one is generated and returned in the response header.

request.description:
Returns one page of quotes ordered by `quoteId`.

- Required scope: `quote:read`
- `page`: zero-based, default 0
- `size`: 1-100, default 20

Responses: `200` with `content`, `page`, `size`, `totalElements`, `totalPages`; `400` `INVALID_QUOTE_REQUEST` (out-of-range values) or `BAD_REQUEST` (non-numeric values); `401`; `403`.

Errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code` and the request's `correlationId`. Send `X-Correlation-Id` (1-64 chars of `A-Za-z0-9._-`) to choose your own; otherwise one is generated and returned in the response header.

request.description:
Creates a quote for an existing customer. Quote Service looks the customer up in Customer Service (client-credentials token, `customer:read`) and derives name and age from the profile.

- Required scope: `quote:create`
- `customerId`: UUID of an existing customer (run *Create customer* first)
- `coverageType`: `AUTO`, `HOME`, `LIFE` or `HEALTH` (case-insensitive); base rates 0.07 / 0.05 / 0.09 / 0.08
- Premium = `coverageAmount` x base rate, +15% when age is over 60, rounded to 2 decimals
- The customer's age must be 18-75

Responses: `201`, `400` `VALIDATION_FAILED` / `INVALID_QUOTE_REQUEST`, `401`, `403`, `422` `CUSTOMER_REFERENCE_INVALID` (unknown customer), `503` `CUSTOMER_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `504` `CUSTOMER_SERVICE_TIMEOUT`, `500` `PERSISTENCE_FAILURE` / `INTERNAL_ERROR`.

Errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code` and the request's `correlationId`. Send `X-Correlation-Id` (1-64 chars of `A-Za-z0-9._-`) to choose your own; otherwise one is generated and returned in the response header.
